description: Detached single storey outbuilding to the rear of the house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (MK-02, MK-01 + Unnamed location plan received 26 February 2019) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the  Side walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - The detached single storey outbuilding shall only be used for a purpose incidental to the enjoyment of the house at the property known as 112 Catherine Gardens described at the top of this decision letter and for no other purpose (e.g. it may not be used as a self-contained dwelling or contain a bedroom, living room or other primary residential accommodation, nor may it be used for business purposes)
Condition : 5 - The proposed outbuilding shall be finished in whitewashed cement render or red bricks to match those used on the front elevation of the house
